title: Tasty Gongura Food Recipe Chart for Weak Friends
title_te: బలహీనమైన స్నేహితుల కోసం రుచికరమైన గోంగూర వంటల చార్ట్
problem: Many girls in my village hostel look pale and get tired quickly because they don't eat enough iron-rich green leaves like gongura and spinach.
idea: A colourful meal chart with cheap, tasty recipes using local green leaves. Gemini gives the recipes and Canva makes the chart for our dining hall. Here you can check your iron-rich habits.

items.title: Gongura dal
items.text: Cook gongura leaves with toor dal. Tasty with rice.

items.title: Palakura curry
items.text: Spinach cooked with a little onion and tomato.

items.title: Thotakura fry
items.text: Amaranth leaves fried lightly with garlic.

items.title: Peanut and jaggery laddu
items.text: A sweet snack made with groundnuts and jaggery.

items.title: Add lemon or amla
items.text: Vitamin C from lemon or amla helps the body take in iron.
items.te: నిమ్మ లేదా ఉసిరి ఇనుము బాగా అందేలా సహాయం చేస్తుంది.

widgets.heading: ✅ My Iron-Strong Week
widgets.intro: Tick the good habits you followed this week.

items.text: I ate green leafy vegetables at least 3 days
I ate dal, chana or groundnuts
I added lemon or ate a guava/amla with meals
items.te: భోజనంతో నిమ్మ, జామ లేదా ఉసిరి తిన్నాను

items.text: I did not drink tea right with my meal
I took the iron tablet given at school, as the teacher/nurse said
items.te: బడిలో ఇచ్చిన ఐరన్ మాత్ర టీచర్/నర్సు చెప్పినట్టు వేసుకున్నాను

items.text: I told the nurse if I felt very tired or dizzy
items.te: బాగా అలసట, కళ్ళు తిరిగితే నర్సుకు చెప్పాను

bands.text: Good! Add one more healthy habit next week.
Let's start with green leaves 3 days a week.

how: Make a list of green leaves easily found in our village (gongura, palakura, thotakura, menthi).
Ask Gemini for 5 cheap and tasty recipes using these leaves.
Check the recipes with our hostel cook or Amma.
Open Canva, search 'menu poster', and make a colourful weekly meal chart.
Add pictures and short Telugu names for each dish.
Print it, stick it near the dining hall, and ask the warden if we can add one dish each week.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student in a Telangana hostel. Many girls are pale and tired. Give me 5 low-cost, tasty recipes using local leafy greens like gongura, spinach and amaranth. Write short steps in simple English and Telugu. Add one tip to help the body absorb iron.
